description: Viser status for et brev sendt af denne konto ud fra dets id: betalt, sendt, og for rekommanderede breve dao's udfald og kvittering, når Postly har modtaget den. English: Shows the status of a letter sent by this account: paid, sent and, for registered letters, dao's outcome and receipt once Postly has it.
name: get_letter_status
title: Hent brevstatus
